summary: Iteration 19 — Change Order module retest + full tab sweep across Admin/SE/Client/Vendor. Found and fixed a CRITICAL blank-page runtime error in ChangeOrderFormModal.jsx (attachments/setAttachments/uploading/fileRef/onFiles were referenced but never declared — this was the root cause of the user-reported blank Change Orders page). After fix: all Change Order flows (create+attachment, phase filter, impact banner, PDF/XLSX export downloads, paperclip badge, pf-variations-panel) work end-to-end. Backend: 60/60 tests pass (16 CO regression + 44 new export/upload/API-sweep tests). No 5xx errors from any endpoint across all roles — Postgres is healthy.

ui_bugs.issue: CRITICAL (FIXED by me): Referenced attachments, setAttachments, uploading, fileRef, onFiles without declaring them. Any Admin/SE opening the Change Orders tab hit `ReferenceError: attachments is not defined` and the whole tab rendered blank (textLen=0). This is the exact bug the user reported. Fix: added useState([]) for attachments, useState(false) for uploading, useRef(null) for fileRef, and an onFiles async handler that POSTs each file to /api/upload and appends {url, filename} to attachments.

issues: Period Start / Period End use browser-native mm/dd/yyyy date pickers instead of the shadcn Calendar component used elsewhere in the app — inconsistent UX.

rca_of_the_issue: USER-REPORTED BUG: 'Change Order page went BLANK'. ROOT CAUSE: ChangeOrderFormModal.jsx was edited to add attachment upload UI (co-attachment-input, co-attachment-preview-N, co-attachment-remove-N) but the corresponding React state and handlers were never declared. When the modal component mounted (even lazily, because it's imported at the top of ChangeOrdersTab), React threw `ReferenceError: attachments is not defined` at first render of the JSX that referenced `attachments.map(...)`. The uncaught error bubbled up and made the entire Change Orders tab render as a blank runtime-error overlay (textLen=0). REPRODUCTION: Login as Admin -> /admin/projects/1 -> click Change Orders tab. Prior to fix: blank page with red 'Uncaught runtime errors: attachments is not defined at ChangeOrderFormModal'. MITIGATION APPLIED: Added `const [attachments, setAttachments] = useState([]); const [uploading, setUploading] = useState(false); const fileRef = useRef(null);` plus an async `onFiles` handler that uploads each file to POST /api/upload and appends {url, filename} to state; also resets attachments to [] whenever the modal opens. VERIFIED: SE created CO-1-005 with a PNG attachment; paperclip badge shows count=1 on the row; both PDF and XLSX exports download successfully; impact banner shows correct text; client priya and admin both see the fully-rendered tab with no errors.
